planSteps.description: Open /login. Switch to English, then back to Arabic.
Email and password inputs and sign-in button are visible in both languages; direction changes LTR then RTL.
Open /login, select English, submit with both fields blank.
Browser required-field validation prevents submission and the user remains on login without authenticated content.
Open /login, select English, enter nonexistent-kohl-qa@test.invalid and Fake-Test-Only-2026! as password, then sign in once.
An Invalid email or password alert appears and no authenticated dashboard is displayed.
Both pages redirect to login or show an explicit access-denied state; no user list or management records appear.
Both routes redirect to login or show access denied; no customer, contract, financial or internal records appear.

name: External and internal pages require authentication
